protocol.objective: sum valid next-token NLL divided by count of nonpadding targets; EOS included
protocol.selection: none; fixed tokenizer merge budget and optimizer; validation descriptive only
protocol.boundaries: BOS/EOS per document; no cross-document training pairs or BPE merges

byte.pretokenization: none; may merge spaces; never cross documents

bpe.pretokenization: none; may merge spaces; never cross documents

tokenizer_audit.character_scope: train-only codepoint tokenizer demonstration, no normalization, explicit UNK; not used for comparable loss experiment

byte.kind: add-one smoothed unigram of training targets includingEOS

byte_bpe.kind: add-one smoothed unigram of training targets includingEOS
